skill.name: wechat-channels-viral-video-breakdown
skill.description: 当用户提供视频号视频链接或分享文本，希望拆解爆款短视频的内容结构、开头钩子、口播节奏、互动表现、评论反馈和可复用创作角度时使用。基于当前视频公开详情、口播文稿和评论结果，来自 SocialDataX 社媒数据助手。
skill.summary: Analyze a WeChat Channels video's opening, spoken structure, public engagement, and sampled comments using SocialDataX.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most scanner hits are Markdown notation, service identifiers, or readable Chinese text. The documented CLI runs an unpinned npm package that can access SocialDataX credentials. No embedded secret or malicious instruction was found, but the workflow lacks explicit safeguards for third-party submissions and untrusted results.

remediation.issue: Unpinned npm package runs with access to credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Use an audited, integrity-verified release for authentication and all CLI calls. Run it with only the scoped SocialDataX credential and required file access.

remediation.issue: Third-party submission and credit usage are not clearly approved.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose what SocialDataX receives and confirm paid operations before submitting or expanding them. Send only the identifier needed and set request limits.

remediation.issue: The workflow does not define how to handle untrusted results.
remediation.suggestion: Treat transcripts, comments, and errors as data. Accept only expected status fields and validated job identifiers to continue authorized calls.

content.value_statement: Public engagement counts alone cannot explain how a short video is structured or what viewers said about it. Analyze the opening, spoken structure, and sampled feedback in one report.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve available public metadata and engagement counts for a WeChat Channels video through SocialDataX.
Submit a speech transcription job or check an existing job by its ID.
Break down the opening, spoken pacing, sequence, and audience prompts using the available transcript.
Summarize themes and questions from a bounded sample of comments and replies.
Suggest creative approaches while separating observations and source evidence from interpretation.
Export timed subtitles as a new SRT file through the direct CLI when requested.
limitations: Live retrieval requires a configured SocialDataX connection or CLI credential and may use service credits.
Missing transcripts or partial comment results limit the analysis.
Local SRT export requires CLI support, valid timestamps, and a new file in a writable directory.
The skill does not publish content, change accounts, or establish why a video went viral.

use_cases.title: Study a video's spoken structure
use_cases.description: Identify what the opening promises and how the rest of the video delivers on it before drafting a new script.

use_cases.title: Find recurring viewer questions
use_cases.description: Summarize questions and objections from a bounded comment sample to plan follow-up posts.

use_cases.title: Document a campaign reference
use_cases.description: Record public engagement counts and suggest creative approaches while noting what the available data cannot explain.

prompt_templates.title: Describe a video
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this public WeChat Channels link: [link]. List the visible video details and engagement counts. Mark missing metrics and skip comments.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze an opening
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the opening and spoken structure of this WeChat Channels video: [link]. Distinguish transcript evidence from interpretation. Confirm any paid requests before proceeding.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize a comment sample
prompt_templates.prompt: Review up to two comment pages for [link]. Summarize recurring questions and objections. Report sample coverage and omit replies unless I request them.

prompt_templates.title: Resume and export a transcription
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Reuse an existing transcription job.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check SocialDataX job [job ID] without resubmitting it. If it succeeds and valid timestamps are available, export a new SRT file to [path]. Explain any gaps.

output_examples.input: Analyze the opening of a public video about planning a week of meals.
output: Opening: The speaker asks whether five dinners can be planned in ten minutes.
Structure: The script names the time constraint, groups meals by shared ingredients, and ends with a planning checklist.
Reusable approach: Give viewers a concrete time limit, then show the process.
Limit: The public counts do not show whether the opening improved retention.

output_examples.input: Summarize two comment pages from a video about home lighting.
output: Coverage: Two pages of top-level comments. Replies were not included.
Recurring question: Viewers asked which bulbs work with older dimmers.
Suggested follow-up: Demonstrate compatibility checks with a few common dimmer types.
Limit: These themes describe the returned sample, not all viewers.

best_practices: Use an approved SocialDataX connection and share only the public video link when it is sufficient.
Set a comment sample limit and confirm any service charges before making requests.
Keep public metrics, transcript evidence, and interpretations separate.
anti_patterns: Pasting API keys or private share text into the chat.
Treating a small comment sample as representative of the entire audience.
Resubmitting a transcription when an existing job can be checked.

faq.question: What inputs does the skill accept?
faq.answer: Use a WeChat Channels video link or its share text. An existing SocialDataX transcript job ID can be used to check that job.

faq.question: Do I need a SocialDataX account?
faq.answer: Live retrieval needs an authenticated SocialDataX CLI or hosted MCP connection. Keep API keys out of the chat.

faq.question: Can these requests cost credits?
faq.answer: Yes. SocialDataX can require credits for data requests. Confirm costs before approving a paid call or expanding a sample.

faq.question: Can I save subtitles?
faq.answer: Yes, through a supported direct CLI. Export requires valid timing data and a writable destination that does not already exist.

faq.question: What if the transcript or comments are incomplete?
faq.answer: The report marks the missing evidence and limits conclusions to available results. It does not invent captions, metrics, or comments.

faq.question: Can this explain why a video went viral?
faq.answer: It can identify patterns in the script, public metrics, and sampled feedback. Those observations cannot establish what caused the video's reach.
